header.title: Basic Information
header.description: Configure the basic details for your assessment including name, schedule, evaluation method, and result release preferences.

basicInfoSection.description: Name, subject, and instructions shown to participants.

liveDateRangeSection.title: Live Date Range
liveDateRangeSection.description: When participants can start and must finish the assessment.

attemptSettingsSection.title: Attempt Settings
attemptSettingsSection.description: Control how participants take this assessment.

autoAfterSubmission.label: Auto — Release after submission
autoAfterSubmission.help: System grades automatically. Results are visible to the learner immediately after they submit.

autoAfterAssessmentEnd.label: Auto — Release after exam ends
autoAfterAssessmentEnd.help: System grades automatically. Results become visible only after the assessment end time passes.

noAutoRelease.label: Auto — Release manually
noAutoRelease.help: System grades automatically. Results stay hidden until you click "Release Result" in the submissions tab.

manual.label: Manual evaluation & release
manual.help: Teacher grades each submission by hand. Results stay hidden until you manually evaluate and release them.

submissionType.label: Submission Type
submissionType.helper: How students submit their answers (e.g., file upload, PDF).

assessmentPreview.description: Let participants preview the assessment before starting.

switchSections.label: Allow {{role}}s to switch between sections
switchSections.description: Participants can jump back and forth between sections.

durationDistribution.label: Duration Distribution
durationDistribution.helper: Choose whether time limits apply to the whole test, per section, or per question.

reattemptRequest.label: Allow Students to Raise Reattempt Request

timeIncreaseRequest.label: Allow Students to Raise Time Increase Request
